fields.description: The Edit at d3 is a three-tower residential development on the waterfront in Dubai Design District. Landscaped sky gardens and shared social spaces connect the scheme’s architecture with its setting. The collection includes one- to four-bedroom apartments and explicitly labelled five-bedroom penthouses in the official plans.

overview: The reviewed examples belong to Tower A. Curved balcony lines create different outdoor areas across otherwise similar apartment types. The five-bedroom A-PH-A penthouse devotes almost as much published area to balconies as to the enclosed suite; its total should not be read as internal living space.
research.locationNote: Dubai Design District, Dubai, as identified by Meraas. Confirm the selected building, entrance and unit outlook on its approved plan; surrounding facilities and travel conditions can change.
research.priceNote: The official payment sheet publishes starting guides of AED 2.0m for one bedroom, AED 4.0m for two bedrooms, AED 5.1m for two bedrooms plus maid, AED 7.7m for three bedrooms, AED 10.7m for four bedrooms and AED 34.1m for a penthouse. These are release guides, not a current unit allocation.
research.paymentNote: The linked developer document uses 20% booking, six construction instalments totalling 55% and 25% at anticipated handover. Some dates have already passed. This is the published release calendar, not confirmation that a new reservation receives those terms; obtain a dated unit offer and remaining-balance statement.
research.handoverNote: The own developer payment sheet states estimated construction completion and handover in June 2030. The selected contract establishes the applicable delivery provisions; no completed inventory is asserted.
